mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 42 degrees at Verona Community Park.

In city news, the Verona Police Department has reported the arrest of a school bus driver on Thursday for O W I while students were on board. Additionally, residents are reminded that updated zoning ordinances and polling locations are available on the city website.

We have a busy schedule of local events today, including the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol, plus live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can find yoga on October 19 and trivia nights starting October 20.

The Verona Police Department released a report regarding an incident on Thursday where a bus driver was arrested for operating while impaired; no injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a potential collision with a sign.
Today's flavor is the decadent Chocolate Volcano. The store is open right now and will remain open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
